Description
50 Gram PAMP Suisse Gold Bar is manufactured by the world’s leading independent precious metal refiner, PAMP(Produits Artistiques Métaux Précieux) Suisse, and is a favorite among investors.
PAMP Suisse
was founded in 1977, in Ticino, Switzerland, and is renowned for its craftsmanship and design of high-quality precious metals all over the world. Pamp suisse 50g gold bars are a suitable choice for those looking to invest in high-quality swiss gold bars.
Each of these 50 g PAMP Suisse Gold Bars contains 50 grams (1.6075 troy oz) of .9999 fine gold and is individually wrapped in PAMPs sealed Veriscan Technology, which includes an assay card. The Veriscan QR code can be found on the reverse packaging. This allows you to verify the product’s unique serial number, weight, and metal content.
The 50 Gram PAMP Suisse Gold Bar – Lady Fortuna features an exclusive Veriscan® Technology that uses the metal’s microscopic topography, similar to a fingerprint, to identify any registered product aiding in the detection of counterfeit gold bars in the market. Each 50 gram pamp suisse lady Fortuna gold bar is scanned during production and, when scanned by the customers, is further authenticated by the Veriscan® database.
The pamp 50 gram gold bar is ideal for investors who appreciate the security and stability of owning
physical gold bullion
. This stunning 50g pamp suisse gold bar is the symbol of prosperity and an excellent gift or investment opportunity.
Design of 50 Gram PAMP Suisse Gold Bar – Lady Fortuna
The PAMP Suisse Gold bars are famous among investors worldwide due to their excellent design. The 50 Gram PAMP Suisse gold bar on the obverse features the Roman Goddess, Lady Fortuna who is believed to be the Goddess of Fortune and Luck according to Roman mythology. Lady Fortuna is depicted in left-profile relief, with a blindfold covering her eyes, clutching a
cornucopia
overflowing with a pile of gold coins, and a wreath crown at her head.
The PAMP logo is depicted at the top of the design space on the reverse of the 50 Gram PAMP Suisse gold bar, with the remaining markings arranged vertically along the bar’s face. The PAMP Logo features the letters PAMP encircled by a four-pointed star, with the word Suisse imprinted beneath. The 50 Gram PAMP Suisse Fortuna Veriscan Gold Bar also includes the weight, purity, metal composition, and serial number on the reverse. The following are the serial numbers for this series: The serial numbers in this series are identified by a one-letter, six-number code.

This ensures that PAMP’s gold bars meet the highest quality and purity standards.
PAMP’s 50 Gram Gold bars make a great choice for long-term savers who value the stability and security of physical gold bullion.
PAMP’s fifty-
gram gold bar
is a portfolio hedge against market risks because of its low correlation to other financial assets.
PAMP’s gold bars have been accepted by the Swiss Central Bank and the LBMA as Good Delivery. This ensures that bullion dealers, investors, and banks worldwide can exchange this gold bar.
